interface.name: zwlr_layer_shell_v1

description.summary: create surfaces that are layers of the desktop

interface.description: Clients can use this interface to assign the surface_extension role to wl_surfaces. Such surfaces are assigned to a "layer" of the output and rendered with a defined z-order relative to each other.

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: create a layer_surface from a surface

request.description: Create a layer surface for a given surface. This assigns the role of layer_surface to the given surface.

interface.name: zwlr_layer_surface_v1
interface.description: An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for surfaces that are designed to be rendered as a layer of a stacked desktop-like environment.

description.summary: types of keyboard interaction for a layer surface
sets the size of the surface
configures the anchor, four edge bitfield
sets a margin from the anchor point
assign this layer_surface as an xdg_popup parent
change the layer of the surface
